method: Actual unaliased graph pair dependency. Exact combinational congruence; one edge per FF-pair dependency. No reset/enable value assumptions or zero initial states.
qualifications: Finite capture bound assumes both corresponding clocks deliver the same legal edge and all controls meet native timing. It does not prove valid observability begins later than the bound.
Unresolved feedback pairs need actual qualified-write/validity lifetime proof; a structural cycle alone is not a counterexample.
Asynchronous assertion/deassertion and abort/restart first-valid joins are not established by this data dependency census.
